subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I enjoy finding ways to make the most of my budget by being _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Frugal'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** sentence is about** maximizing the use of one's budget.
 
• The **blank should be filled** with a word that denotes careful or sparing use of money.
 
• **"Frugal"** (मितव्ययी) means economical in use or expenditure; not wasteful.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *"I enjoy finding ways to make the most of my budget by being frugal."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Lethargic"** (आलसी) means sluggish and lacking in energy, and does not relate to the context.
 
• **"Miser"** (कंजूस) refers to a person who hoards money and avoids spending, but this term can have a negative connotation.
 
• **"Gloomy"** (उदास) means dark or dim; deeply shaded, and is not related to the context of the sentence.
